head: codex/5710-csdlc-v2-closeout-safe-prune-recovery
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][closeout] Repair terminal closeout and safe-prune recovery
body:
Closes #5710

## Summary

- reconcile metadata-only terminal publication head drift before typed closeout
- validate terminal disposition before any readiness mutation
- classify and retain issue evidence before fail-closed worktree pruning
- reject staged, unrelated-lock, substantive, and unclassified dirty state
- classify stranded closed issues with executable recovery actions

## Validation

- `cargo fmt --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --all --check`
- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate7_lifecycle` (`37 passed`)
- bounded subagent review completed; six findings fixed; final review found no actionable findings

## Boundary

The post-merge v0.91.8 live recovery sweep remains a closeout-stage proof and is not claimed by this pre-merge PR.
